settings.eyebrow: Fairway Forge Golf Academy · Private coaching · Simulator + range
settings.headline: Every swing starts with a plan.
settings.copy: We don't sell you a swing. We build you one — frame by frame, from the grip to the follow-through, using launch-monitor data and coaches who have been there. Whether it's your first tee box or your fifth handicap, you'll leave every session knowing exactly what to work on.

trust_list.text: Launch-monitor swing analysis on every visit
Video review you can take home
Simulator bays open 7 days a week

stats.label: Simulator bays, one for every mood

settings.title: Training built around
settings.intro: No one-size fits-all lesson plans here. Pick the path that matches your goal — then we'll adjust it to your body, your tempo, and your schedule.

design.title: Private coaching
design.text: Hour-long, one-on-one sessions with a launch monitor and video, so every tweak is measurable — not just a feeling.

design.title: Game-plan series
design.text: A four-session arc that builds your swing from grip to full swing, ending with a round-plan you can actually follow.

build.title: Junior academy
build.text: Weekly clinics for ages 7–15 that teach the swing and the love of the game — small groups, patient coaches, real course days.

build.title: Group clinics
build.text: Six-player max clinics on short game, full swing, and course strategy. Enough feedback to matter, enough fun to keep coming back.

launch.title: Simulator leagues
launch.text: Play 30 of the world's great courses on our trackman sims — solo practice, friend leagues, or a cold-weather round when it's snowing.

launch.title: Club fitting
launch.text: Data-driven fittings for irons, woods, and putters so your equipment stops fighting your swing.

settings.title: More than
settings.intro: The difference between a golf academy and a place that sells time on a mat: the first one leaves you with a repeatable system. Here's what that looks like here.

features.title: Data you can trust
features.text: Every lesson runs through a launch monitor and video. Your progress is measured in numbers and frames, not just 'feeling better.'

features.title: Coaches who teach, not just play
features.text: Our coaches are certified instructors first, competitive players second. They explain the why behind every drill.

features.title: A plan that travels
features.text: You leave with a written game plan and a drill card — so the work continues at the range or in your backyard between visits.

features.title: Play in any weather
features.text: Seven simulator bays mean winter, rain, or a packed weekend never cancels your practice.

features.title: Real course connection
features.text: We partner with three local courses for on-course lessons, so what you learn in the bay carries to the fairway.

features.title: A community that plays
features.text: Weekly leagues, demo days, and member socials keep the game social — improvement is more fun with a group.

settings.title: Your first month,
settings.intro: Here's what it looks like to get started at Fairway Forge — from first assessment to your first confident round.

steps.title: Book your assessment
steps.text: An hour with a coach, launch monitor, and video — we map your current swing and set a measurable target.

steps.title: Build your plan
steps.text: You get a written game plan: which sessions, which drills, and what 'success' looks like at each step.

steps.title: Practice with purpose
steps.text: Between lessons, use the sim bays and range with a drill card tailored to your session's takeaways.

steps.title: Play the round
steps.text: Take it to the course. We review your round on video and reset the plan for the next month of improvement.

settings.note: Fairway Forge is built for consistency: measurable goals, a written plan, and coaches who follow your progress across every visit — not just the lesson.

settings.title: What players
settings.intro: We asked our players what changed. Their answers were about confidence and consistency — the things you can't buy with a bigger driver.

reviews.quote: I'd been stuck at a 14 handicap for three years, taking lessons that felt good but went nowhere. In four months at Fairway Forge I broke 90 twice. The launch-monitor feedback finally made my practice count.
reviews.author: Dana W.

reviews.quote: My son joined the junior academy at 11, still scared of the first tee. Two years later he's playing in his school's varsity lineup and, more importantly, he can't wait for Saturday practice.
reviews.author: Raj P.

reviews.quote: The simulator league saved my winter. I kept my swing all season and came into spring two months ahead of where I normally am. It's a genuine community, not just a place to hit balls.
reviews.author: Mara K.

settings.title: Coaches who
settings.intro: Every coach here teaches full-time. No part-time pros, no 'hit a few balls and call it a lesson' — just certified instructors who study the game.

members.name: Elena Marsh
members.bio: 20 years teaching, LPGA pro. Elena designs every academy curriculum and still teaches a full private schedule.

members.name: Tom Okafor
members.bio: A former collegiate coach, Tom runs the junior academy and has developed three state-level junior champions.

members.name: Grace Liu
members.bio: Grace heads our club-fitting program and sim leagues, pairing data with an eye for what fits a real player.

settings.intro: Come try a session, tour the bays, or just ask a question — a real coach replies within one business day.
